messages:
ashley: Quick question — for the cost dashboard, can we show a separate line for 'prefetch credit delta' so product teams can see when prefetching increases billable tokens vs saved cache hits? wondering how invasive this is to the current token-lineage pipeline.

raj: short answer: doable but a few caveats. prefetch credits are derived after we reconcile KV/cache reuse in the batcher. adding a derived 'delta' metric means either (A) compute at ingest (heavy) or (B) compute in the rollup layer (approx).

maria: analytics note: if we compute in rollup layer we lose per-invocation attribution for samples. sampling bias will make small routes look either better or worse depending on sample rate. we currently sample 1/100 by default.

kevin: UX idea: show a compact diff widget next to per-route cost sparkline. two tiny numbers: "prefetch +X%" in green, "net tokens +Y" in grey. tooltip explains "prefetch credits = estimated tokens saved by cache hits; delta = prefetch tokens issued - actual cache hits credited". simple and low noise.

raj: implementation sketch: add a new rollup column prefetch_issued, prefetch_credited. rollup job emits daily aggregates: total_prefetch_issued, total_prefetch_credited. delta = issued - credited. query example:```sql
SELECT route_id, sum(prefetch_issued) as issued, sum(prefetch_credited) as credited, sum(issued)-sum(credited) as delta
FROM rollups.prefetch_daily
WHERE day >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY route_id;``` this avoids per-invocation work.

maria: +1 for rollup approach but we should also surface confidence bands. when sample_rate < 0.01, show a "low confidence" badge and link to sampling settings.

cost-bot: Automated snapshot: prefetch_issued=1,243,210 tokens; prefetch_credited=1,101,900 tokens; delta=141,310 tokens (+11.4%). source: rollups.prefetch_daily (2026-03-15).

ashley: thanks — two follow-ups: 1) billing implications: do we want delta to feed the per-tenant chargeback preview? 2) rollout plan for console: should this be behind an experimentation toggle or visible to all?

raj: 1) i'd prefer delta as an explanatory metric (visibility only) not as a billing line until we validate the estimator for 30 days. 2) behind feature flag + opt-in in console for early adopters. smaller blast radius.

kevin: from UX: behind a toggle with a checklist: sampling >= X, 30d validation, link to explainability modal. also add a short help copy: "How prefetch affects cost".

maria: ops: we should store both raw counts and sample_rate at rollup time to recompute CI later. add fields: sample_n, sample_denom.

oliver: quick infra question — will rollup add meaningful windowed compute? if so we need to bump job size. raj, can you ballpark?

raj: ballpark: +20% CPU on rollup workers if we emit prefetch columns and confidence calcs. storage growth negligible (two ints per row). we can gate with flag to avoid cluster changes until validated.

ashley: ok plan: (1) raj adds rollup columns behind flag, (2) kevin wires minimal diff UI, (3) maria validates sample bias and posts results after 30d, (4) standup decision on billing use. I'll draft the feature spec and add to the roadmap. thanks team :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll mock the tiny diff widget today and post screenshots.

maria: I'll add analytics checks and an automated notebook to compare sampled vs ground truth on a 1% backup sample.

cost-bot: Feature flag created: rollup.prefetch_delta (id: ff_prefetch_2026_03_15).

ashley: perfect — leaving follow-ups in the thread. anyone else?
